bundle.shortDescription: Keystroke, keyboard and mouse visualizer for tutorial recording
bundle.longDescription: IDEA Keystage shows keystrokes, a keyboard and the mouse on screen and in OBS while you record SolidWorks tutorials. It runs on this computer only: it makes no network requests and never shows what you type in password fields.
